tagline: Versioned numbers, versioned words, one traceable loop.
description: An open-source Clinical Study Report builder: ARD-first TFLs, an ICH E3 document model, and a published requirements-to-evidence framework.

study.title: Safety and Efficacy of the Xanomeline Transdermal Therapeutic System (TTS) in Patients with Mild to Moderate Alzheimer's Disease

documents.title: Clinical Study Report
documents.blurb: The ICH E3 report assembled from the text library and the display library.

documents.title: Study Synopsis
documents.blurb: The ICH E3 Annex I synopsis of the same study, assembled from the same ARDs and the same values store as the report. Its prose is unreviewed draft.

documents.title: Statistical Analysis Plan
documents.blurb: Planned. Needs a SAP template in library/templates/ before it can assemble.

documents.title: Post-Text Display Package
documents.blurb: Every post-text table, listing and figure the report carries, in the report's own numbering and without the narrative around them — the bundle a reviewer opens when they want the displays and not the prose.

documents.title: Abbreviated Clinical Study Report (ICH E3)
documents.blurb: The same prose and the same displays as the full report, in the shorter document model ICH E3 allows for a study not intended to support an efficacy claim — the reuse case that proves two reports of one study cannot drift apart a display at a time.

components.title: TFL Engine
components.blurb: The R package that turns ADaM into ARDs and ARDs into displays: data-prep, the analysis.yaml interpreter, the owned ard.json serialization, and the gt/tfrmt/r2rtf renderers.

components.title: Text Library
components.blurb: ICH E3-aligned prose blocks in three tiers, binding every number to an ARD address rather than stating it.

components.title: Report Template Library
components.blurb: ICH E3 encoded as data — the 16-section skeleton, assembly slots, 14.x numbering, and the auto-generated 16.1.9 provenance appendix.

components.title: Traceability
components.blurb: The data to ARD to display to sentence chain: provenance envelopes, iteration ledgers, and the trace panel that answers all five questions about any number on the site.

components.title: Quality Framework
components.blurb: The requirements to tests to evidence loop itself: matrix extraction, test-name conventions, evidence normalization across testthat and vitest, drift guards, and the published evidence pages.

displays.title: Demographic and Baseline Characteristics
displays.blurb: Age, sex, race and baseline characteristics by treatment arm over the safety analysis set.

displays.title: Subject Disposition
displays.blurb: Screened, randomised, treated, completed and discontinued counts with reasons for discontinuation, over the ITT set.

displays.title: Summary of Populations
displays.blurb: How many subjects each analysis is run on — ITT, safety and efficacy — by planned treatment group, with percentages over the group's randomised N. The denominator every other display's N is checked against.

displays.title: Summary of End of Study Data
displays.blurb: Who finished and who left, with the reason. Nine reasons for early termination plus a missing-reason row, partitioning the early terminations exactly, and a p-value on only the three rows the analysis plan names.

displays.title: Time to Dermatologic Event by Treatment Group
displays.blurb: The study's only figure: Kaplan-Meier curves for time to a first dermatologic event, by treatment group, with medians, confidence limits and a log-rank test. Xanomeline is delivered transdermally, so this is the tolerability question the delivery route raises.

displays.title: Primary Endpoint Analysis: CIBIC+ — Summary at Week 24 — LOCF
displays.blurb: The study's other primary endpoint: the clinician's global impression of change at Week 24, with the same ANCOVA structure as the ADAS-Cog table beside it.

displays.title: CIBIC+ — Summary at Week 8 — LOCF
displays.blurb: The CIBIC+ global impression read at Week 8, same model.

displays.title: CIBIC+ — Summary at Week 16 — LOCF
displays.blurb: The CIBIC+ global impression read at Week 16, same model.

displays.title: CIBIC+ — Categorical Analysis — LOCF
displays.blurb: CIBIC+ as categories rather than a mean — how many subjects fell in each impression band at three visits, with a stratified Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test across treatment groups.

displays.title: Primary Endpoint Analysis: ADAS-Cog (11) - Change from Baseline to Week 24 - LOCF
displays.blurb: The study's primary efficacy result: change in ADAS-Cog (11) from baseline to Week 24, with the ANCOVA dose response and both pairwise comparisons against placebo.

displays.title: ADAS-Cog (11) - Change from Baseline to Week 8 - LOCF
displays.blurb: The same primary analysis read at Week 8, with the same model and the same last-observation-carried-forward rule.

displays.title: ADAS-Cog (11) - Change from Baseline to Week 16 - LOCF
displays.blurb: The same primary analysis read at Week 16 — the middle of the three scheduled reads.

displays.title: ADAS-Cog (11) - Change from Baseline to Week 24 - Completers at Week 24, Observed Cases, Windowed
displays.blurb: Week 24 restricted to subjects who completed it, observed cases only, with no value carried forward. The sensitivity analysis against the primary table's imputation.

displays.title: ADAS-Cog (11) - Change from Baseline to Week 24 in Male Subjects - LOCF
displays.blurb: The Week 24 primary analysis in male subjects alone. Subgroup, not a separate endpoint.

displays.title: ADAS-Cog (11) - Change from Baseline to Week 24 in Female Subjects - LOCF
displays.blurb: The Week 24 primary analysis in female subjects alone. Subgroup, not a separate endpoint.

displays.title: ADAS-Cog (11) - Mean and Mean Change from Baseline over Time
displays.blurb: ADAS-Cog scores and their change from baseline at every scheduled visit, so the shape of the trajectory is visible rather than just its endpoints. Presented with treatment across the columns.

displays.title: ADAS-Cog (11) - Repeated Measures Analysis of Change from Baseline to Week 24
displays.blurb: The supportive repeated-measures analysis: a mixed model with an unstructured within-subject covariance, which handles a missed visit through the covariance rather than by carrying a value forward. Its fit reproduces the reference report's own PROC MIXED output to six significant figures.

displays.title: Mean NPI-X Total Score from Week 4 through Week 24 - Windowed
displays.blurb: The secondary endpoint — mean NPI-X total score across the Weeks 4 to 24 window. The one display where the study's analysis metadata and its own published report disagree about which score to use, and the footnotes say which side was taken.

displays.title: Overview of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events
displays.blurb: Subject counts for any AE, related AEs, serious AEs, and AEs leading to discontinuation or death.

displays.title: Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events by System Organ Class and Preferred Term
displays.blurb: Hierarchical subject incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events, SOC rows expanded to preferred terms.

displays.title: Extent of Exposure to Study Drug
displays.blurb: Duration and cumulative dose of study treatment by arm.

displays.title: Listing of Serious Adverse Events
displays.blurb: Subject-level listing of serious adverse events with onset, severity, outcome and relationship.

displays.title: Summary of Concomitant Medications
displays.blurb: Subjects taking at least one concomitant medication, and subject counts by therapeutic class and coded medication.

displays.title: Summary of Vital Signs at Baseline and End of Treatment
displays.blurb: Blood pressure and pulse in three positions, at baseline, Week 24 and end of treatment, by planned treatment.

displays.title: Summary of Vital Signs Change from Baseline at End of Treatment
displays.blurb: The same measurements as a change from each subject's own observed Week 0 value.

displays.title: Summary of Weight and Weight Change from Baseline at End of Treatment
displays.blurb: Weight and weight change from baseline at Week 24 and end of treatment.

displays.title: Incidence of Treatment Emergent Adverse Events by Treatment Group
displays.blurb: The reference report's Table 14-5.01: subjects, percentages and event counts per system organ class and preferred term, with Fisher's exact test of placebo against each active arm.

displays.title: Incidence of Treatment Emergent Serious Adverse Events by Treatment Group
displays.blurb: The reference report's Table 14-5.02: the serious treatment-emergent events, counted and tested the same way as the full incidence table.

displays.title: Summary of Number of Subjects By Site
displays.blurb: The reference report's Table 14-1.03: intent-to-treat, efficacy and Week 24 completer counts per site and treatment group, small sites pooled under id 900.

displays.title: Subject Disposition
displays.blurb: The reference report's Figure 10-1: subjects screened, screen failures, randomised, completed Week 24 and completed the study, drawn as a flow from the study's SDTM DM and its ADSL.
